title: "react/no-unsafe"
description: "Disallow the `UNSAFE_` lifecycle methods of class components"
# Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit below this line.
plugin: "react"

`UNSAFE_componentWillMount`, `UNSAFE_componentWillReceiveProps`, and `UNSAFE_componentWillUpdate` run before React commits a render. React can start a render, drop it, and start again, so these methods can run several times for one update. A request or a subscription started there is then started several times, and may never be cleaned up.

| Instead of | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `UNSAFE_componentWillMount` | `componentDidMount` |
| `UNSAFE_componentWillReceiveProps` | `getDerivedStateFromProps` |
| `UNSAFE_componentWillUpdate` | `componentDidUpdate` |

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}
```jsx
class Feed extends React.Component {
  UNSAFE_componentWillMount() {
    this.subscription = subscribe(this.props.channel);
  }
}
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```jsx
class Feed extends React.Component {
  componentDidMount() {
    this.subscription = subscribe(this.props.channel);
  }
}
```

## Options

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checkAliases` | `false` | Also report the old names without the prefix: `componentWillMount`, `componentWillReceiveProps`, and `componentWillUpdate`. |

{/* bad {"options": [{"checkAliases": true}]} */}
```jsx
class Feed extends React.Component {
  componentWillMount() {
    this.subscription = subscribe(this.props.channel);
  }
}
```
